purpose: Candidate protocol for learning from reviewed, independently checked engineering trajectories
model_selection_gate: Compare a small suitable base/code model and the existing no-training baseline on held-out task groups before selecting size or claiming improvement

later_candidates.DPO: Consider only reviewed chosen/rejected candidates for the same prompt, with valid independent preference evidence; do not invent pairs from unrelated personas
later_candidates.GRPO: Consider only after a reliable bounded execution reward, reward-hacking checks, compute estimate and fresh approval exist

evaluation: End-to-end issue resolution under independent held-out tests
Tenant/scope violations and false success claims
not_a_claim: No method is perfect or established as best for OwnStack. No new model training or paid compute is authorized by this recipe.
